name: Four Seasons Hotel Los Angeles at Beverly Hills
insider_take: This Beverly Hills icon sits on the legendary Golden Triangle, where A-listers shop Rodeo Drive and dealmakers dine at poolside cabanas overlooking the Hollywood Hills.
whats_special: The hotel's fourth-floor rooftop pool deck offers unobstructed views of the Hollywood sign, while the ground-floor Culina restaurant features an open-kitchen concept where celebrity chef José Andrés once held residency. The property occupies the same block where the original Beverly Hills Hotel trolley once stopped in the 1920s.
pro_tip: Book a spa treatment during golden hour – the west-facing treatment rooms offer stunning sunset views over Century City's skyline while you relax.
dont_miss: The hotel's art collection features rotating contemporary pieces, and the lobby's living wall contains over 1,000 plants. Step outside to explore the Beverly Hills sign (just two blocks away) or catch a glimpse of the famous Greystone Mansion, a 5-minute drive north where countless Hollywood films have been shot.
pros: Prime Beverly Hills location with easy access to Rodeo Drive and entertainment venues
Exceptional Four Seasons service with personalized attention and luxury amenities
Rooftop pool and spa offering panoramic city views
Award-winning dining experiences and celebrity chef restaurants
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflecting Beverly Hills location
High-traffic area with potential for crowds and paparazzi activity
